subject: Finite exact selected states,cycle boundaries and Lean proof model
summary: Candidate finite selected-state table,structural recurrence equality and finite use tree with exact boundary witnesses;accepted OWNER041/043/044 behaviours retained;mechanisms unadopted.

authority.notes: Owner requested proposal/proof-plan preparation from the named handoff;this does not adopt recommendations.

source_refs.note: Current owner explicitly requests following next_actions.

content.change: Propose a finite frozen selected-state table and finite occurrence-use result;compare scoped one-step exact row descriptors on an active branch and retain exact target/ancestor references at cycle boundaries. Provide PROP006-008 definition/lemma/measure/coverage/navigation proof plan.
content.rationale: Cyclic saved inclusion and finite historical same-identity use require more than identity/path/global-visited detection;per-use context and exact selected continuation must remain distinct.
constraints: OWNER041/043/044 are accepted;proposal does not change their choices.
Mechanism/status stays proposed;no persistent format,implementation,proof or canonical ownership adoption.
Preserve raw source,logical IDs,immutable history,workspace-user authority and architecture layouts/navigation.
No application/runtime/provider/trust/publication action or coordinating-chat acknowledgment loop.
acceptance_criteria: Owner review of exact state-key and boundary/result semantics before corresponding Lean definitions are treated as selected.
Prove key soundness/active invariants,termination/coverage/determinism and warning/manual-action properties for PROP006-008;do not claim they exist now.
Cover self/mutual cycles,repeated siblings,finite historical same identity,shared manifest with different descendants and alias cases.
Distinguish complete-under-rule from missing/denied/budget/unresolved selection and from conflict review.
Later separately validate actual Rust/UI/source-emitter/permission/recovery correspondence;preserve existing proof scopes.
open_questions: Adopt one-step descriptor equality plus exact boundary witness/use-tree semantics,or choose a reviewed alternative?
Timestamp precision/missing/incomparable cases and detailed marker/resolution mechanics remain unadopted;conservative Ask is only a recommendation.
Source-emission boundary encoding and eventual record/version/capability compatibility need separate concrete design.
risks: Finite graph unfolding can produce many uses;budgets must fail explicitly,not silently truncate.
Scoped handle aliases can change where a non-minimized cycle is cut;the candidate is not a bisimulation quotient.
A model proof cannot establish browser visibility,authentication/crypto/storage correctness or deployed implementation correspondence.
